[h1]《Dice of Kalma》简评[/h1] 这款暗黑风格“骰子”形式的卡组构建肉鸽游戏，别看页面相当的简洁，游戏内容也不算多，但是整体的游戏体验还是蛮不错滴，需要策略、亿点难度、看点运气、有些上头。有一说一，本作20元左右的价位，还是挺值得的。尤其是游戏的页面甚至可以所到很小的矩形，再加上单机游戏说停就停，就非常适合划水摸鱼或者放松心情时候开一局。 [h1]背景设定[/h1] 玩家扮演的主角，他人死了，灵魂进入到了冥界，被冥界守护者拦住，要求与其进行对决，如果主角胜利的话，就可以返回人间以人类的身份继续活下去。至于对决的方式，就是本作的玩法，“骰子”形式的卡组构建肉鸽游戏。 游戏玩法[/h1] 将五个骰子进行投掷，根据投掷出来的点数，计算获得分数。 如果对某（多）个骰子不满意，只要有重掷次数，便可以选中后重新投掷。（和其它游戏不同，其它游戏选中锁死，本作选中则是重掷。） 骨头*倍率的数值，即为本回合获得的总分数。 骨头——基础分数，为骰子点数的总和；倍率——和牌型相关，牌型包括高点骰、一对、两对、三条、满堂彩（三加二）、四条、顺子、五骰同花灯牌型。 在有限回合数内（出牌次数），分数达到指定目标，便算胜利。 每一局游戏胜利，角色便会升级，升级奖励包括骷髅牌（类似遗物）的选择和随机牌型升级（牌型倍率）。 [h1]构筑策略[/h1] 本作的构筑策略，是基于“分数=骨头*倍率”这么一个公式，搭配点数、牌型和骷髅牌，从而实现整体的构筑。由于本作没有图鉴系统，所以骷髅牌这个“遗物”具体有多少个不得而知，但是骷髅牌的作用在游戏里还是非常明显的。当玩家掷出的骰子（首发、重掷看词条），满足骷髅牌的激活效果，便可以提供非常可观的增益效果（骨头和倍率都有）。前期玩家的骷髅牌数量还不多的时候，这个效果加持还不太明显。随着每通过一关便获得一枚骷髅牌，越往后骷髅牌数量越多，不同骷髅牌之间的关联也越强。要知道“骨头*倍率”这个是乘法计算，任何一个数值的增加，都有可能带来极大的变化，这就给玩家非常大的操作空间。在此之中，玩家选择升级的牌型也需要根据骷髅牌来决定，毕竟某些牌型出现的概率会因为某些骷髅牌的存在而大幅提升。不过，这一切的前提就是玩家需要规划好骷髅牌和牌型的升级方式，也就是构筑策略，在出牌和重掷次数相当有限的情况下，运气是真的靠不住，很合一步致使骰子、牌型搭配不当，都可能使得总分和目标之间的差距非常悬殊。这就是本作的难点，其实挺不容易的，各种算算算，也很头大。 [h1]最后[/h1] 让我们来一场酣（机）畅（关）淋（算）漓（尽）的骰子对决吧！ [quote] 我的游戏真的有那么好玩吗? 关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34823631/]“我的游戏不可能那么好玩！”鉴赏家[/url],这是你从未体验过的船新版本~ [/quote]

又一款骰子类的“小丑牌”作品，它有些类似前段时间的骰子阿瓦隆，同样采取肉鸽卡组构建的方式来构筑一组骰子，并需要在冥界中通过骰子点数组合积累分数，挑战新的分数，最终战胜守护者卡尔玛逃离冥界。游戏核心机制在于将骰子博弈与卡组构建深度绑定，通过构筑骷髅，重新投掷来获得更加高的分数，适合喜欢挑战运气，钻研策略的玩家。 游戏的画风算是近期极其有特色的一种，整个背景基本上用了1bit的黑白光点来构成图案，而中间则是彩色的模块池和骷髅卡尔玛，整个画风简洁明了又突出重点，让玩家可以很轻易的分辨出游戏的核心之处，上手也十分进简单，但与此同时简单的画风下，摇骰子的动画，卡尔玛的目光等动效又十分细腻，整体感觉相当有质感。 尽管游戏美术和操作都偏向极简，但本作策略深度却远超预期。尤其是基于骰子之外的骷髅饰品系统是其核心亮点，每种骷髅不仅有独立的可爱插画（如戴古怪帽子的勇者骷髅、头上花朵的花店骷髅）等等，更具备独特的派系属性，涵盖倍率加成、牌型强化、重掷优化等多种效果。玩家需要根据当前骰子池特性和关卡需求，构建专属流派，比如说玩对子、玩顺子等等，一切都取决于玩家每轮的选择与积累。​ 此外，在细节设计上游戏也比较贴心，并进一步提升了策略维度，可以通过长按确认牌型按钮预览分数，避免误操作失误，差一点分晋级失败，这一贴心功能对不擅长快速计算的玩家极为友好，而游戏流程基本就是一轮得分，一轮骷髅和牌型选择，可以说是较为简单的升级规划模式，每次都需要在不同骷髅中进行三选一机制，来打造专属的牌组，不过需要注意的是游戏中很多的骷髅触发起来会比较困男。​ 其实本作的核心还是以“掷骰赌自由”为核心设定，构建了极简却极具成瘾性的玩法循环。玩家需在冥界中通过骰子点数组合积累分数，逐步降低关卡阈值以推进进程，另一个决策点在于每轮投掷后可重掷不满意的骰子，从而追求福尔豪斯、顺子、甚至是四同、五同等等超级大牌型；而通关后的骷髅选择，则如同《Balatro》的小丑牌系统，为玩法注入策略变量，这些设计让每局游戏都充满差异化可能。 ​ 总体来说，作为一款小型游戏，《Dice of Kalma》的展现出的可玩性还是不错的，只不过比起小丑牌来说，整体的数据变量较小，骷髅卡牌池也没那么丰富，所以想要尝试此类作品的话，是个不错的消遣甜点，要是说深度确实不如《Balatro》《Clover Pit》这些同类佳作，尤其是游戏整体的关卡类型相对单一，若后续能加入更多场景变化、Boss 战机制或隐藏骷髅卡牌，就能进一步丰富游戏replay value，所以期待后续更新吧，不过就现有内容而言，也算是一款有些特色的肉鸽小品。 [quote] 游玩百态，将游玩心得用汉语化作玩家的指明灯，(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402408/]点击这里关注汉化语录~[/url] 如果喜欢这个评测，请点个赞让更多人看见 [/quote]

[h1]肉鸽+骰子+德州=爽！[/h1] [h2]游戏推荐指数：★★★★★★★★☆☆[/h2] [quote]买肯定是要买的，玩肯定是不玩的 快来关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38222893/] G胖受害者鉴赏家[/url] 让选择游戏变得更加简单[/quote] 游戏玩法本质上是骰子+德州扑克+肉鸽的结合体，基本3min左右即可上手，一把大概在40min左右，玩家通过不同的骰子组合的点数与“骷髅卡”的倍数相乘在三轮内达到预定分数来进入下一关，游戏供给予了25关，大概失败个7-8次左右玩家差不多就能通关了，游戏的各种骷髅牌和组合升级所给予成长曲线设计不错，使得游戏的游玩体验逐步上升。 比较可惜的是游戏目前只有这样一个闯关模式，要是能设计一个无尽模式或者拓展一下玩法就好了，玩家后期只能不断通关或者不断刷新自己的最高得分记录进行游玩，总体上讲作为一款售价22的小体量游戏来讲本作的玩法设计是足够优秀的。 喜欢德州或者卡牌肉鸽的玩家推荐尝试一下，游戏目前还没有给出本地化的游戏标题《Dice of Kalma》翻译为《冥界亡骰》或者《卡尔玛之骰》感觉都不错，期待工作室的下一个作品。 [quote][h3]鉴赏员测评配置：[/h3] CPU：RYZEN 7600X GPU：AMD 7900XTX 加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GgamePlayer] G胖受害者鉴赏组[/url] 和鉴赏员一起战斗！爽！ [/quote]

[h2] 零和博弈的肉鸽游戏 [/h2] 这是一款骰点数+肉鸽+德州扑克集一体的游戏《Dice of Kalma》，游戏的玩法内核主要是肉鸽的策略+赌博性质的骰点数，游戏上手是非常容易，一般接触过扑克牌或麻将的玩家，基本玩一局就懂得规则了，当然游戏也有详细的新手教程，而剩下的胜利就交给幸运女神。 虽然说是肉鸽游戏，但肉鸽玩法更多是为玩家提供“如何挣更高的分”一个策略性思路玩法，但其实胜利有八成都是依靠骰子点数去赌，所以在开了一局后其实非常容易上头，但游戏的平衡性其实很差，根据我个人统计，有大部分失败都是在第四关里直接结束，而到后面无论依靠肉鸽词条或倍率计算怎么最大化利用，但终究还是需要运气的成分。 游戏是有目标和通关的，就是和骷髅人玩的一个“博弈”游戏，有25关，每一关都有指标分数，根据骰子的点数、点数牌型、词条倍率等堆叠，在一定的出牌次数内获取目标分数就能到下一关，而每一关的分数都会大幅度提升，如果你运气不好都是杂乱的点数牌型，而不同的牌型对应的分数也不同。 [h2] 天胡概率统计计算 [/h2] 共计6^5 =7776种结果 1.[AABCD]（只有一个对子）有3600种结果，46.30%概率 2. [AABBC]（只有两个对子）有1800种结果，23.15%概率 3. [AAABC]（只有三条）有1200种结果，15.43%概率 4. [AAABB]（三带一对）有300种结果，3.86%概率 5. [AAAAB]（四条）有150种结果，1.93%概率 6. [AAAAA]（五条）有6种结果，0.08%概率 7. [顺子]有240种结果，3.09%概率 8. [杂牌]，有480种结果，6.17%概率 exactly≠100% 当然游戏里也有三次或更多次数的重骰机会，可以任选1~5个骰子来重骰，能让你投出更好的牌型，以上只是初始骰子的概率情况，在重骰的情况下，或许可能会有1/36或1/6的情况下能出更好的牌型，但归根结底还是运气游戏。 我也在游戏中尝试过8次重骰一个骰子，没有出现心仪的数字，导致牌型直接变成杂牌，输掉了游戏，而这个概率足足有23.26%（5/6的八次方）这么高，所以游戏单纯就是零和博弈，如果你想通关游戏，那么只能祝你好运。 [h2] 结语 [/h2] 《Dice of Kalma》是一款非常不错的游戏，虽然融入了肉鸽元素，但归根结底还是运气游戏，游戏中也没有其他手段可以强制换点数，肉鸽更多是提供分数的倍率，如果喜欢零和博弈的运气游戏那么可以推荐看看。 [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

[h1][b]《Dice of Kalma》——敢与死神玩骰子？回你棺材里去吧！[/b][/h1] [hr][/hr] [h3]【游戏玩法】[/h3] 游戏没有什么复杂的UI界面，像素+暗黑风的画面可以很好地将玩家的注意力聚焦在玩法上，只有中间的骰子棋盘和上方一个哔哔赖赖不停的死神[spoiler]（甚至还会发表评价吐槽你）[/spoiler]，想必能成为极简主义者的最爱了吧哈哈。 在棋盘上，5个骰面点数之和即为基础分数，又被称为“骨头”（蓝绿色方框）；红色方框的是“倍率”，只有满足指定牌型和一些骷髅牌所列条件才能获得对应倍率并计入其中；“骨头”和“倍率”的乘积则为当前出牌的总得分（长按“出牌”按钮可以预览本次得分），三次出牌的得分之和大于当前目标分数就能进入下一等级；每当完成一个等级后，就会出现骷髅牌三选一以及牌型升级四选一；一场战斗一共有25个等级，全部完成即可通关。 以上是基础规则，非常简单，第一把都是新手教程，过一遍就全都会了。虽然上手很容易，但要想通关却非常难，不仅仅是每次投骰子要灵活应变，不能一味地去追求基础分数高，而忽视了还要满足牌型去凑高倍率，毕竟3×3远比5×1的得分更高，因此有时保留多个低点数骰子去拿较高点数骰子重掷，或许效果更佳。 [h3]【经验之谈】[/h3] 虽然每次投骰子凑牌型很依赖运气，而且由于重掷次数较少导致操作空间也非常有限，所以更要利用好每次的“局外”成长，一是牌型升级，二是骷髅牌选择。 [list] [*][b]牌型升级：[/b]我个人比较倾向于保守玩法，总是优先升级低等级的牌型（毕竟更容易出现），尤其是热衷于点数6，每次看到“高点数”牌型（骰面带6）就喜欢拿，以此让基础分数稍高的同时，倍率也能稍微提升一点（虽然不如冒险打法收益高就是了）。 [*][b]骷髅牌选取：[/b]基于我上述的打法，皇家骷髅我是必拿的，只要出牌时包含点数为6的就生效；其次是一些很容易满足的条件，我也优先拿。有几个骷髅牌强力推荐：守卫骷髅（第三次出牌时生效，非常容易满足）、军官骷髅（出牌时有骰子点数等于其位置序号，非常容易触发）、圣诞骷髅（上一关卡结束时无剩余出牌次数，这个需要注意一下）。 [/list] [h3]【不足之处】[/h3] [olist] [*]部分骷髅牌的生效条件解释得不清楚，存在翻译错误。比如守卫骷髅的“关卡最后一手牌”应改为“（当前等级）关卡最后一次出牌”，其他地方同样把“出牌”误译为“手牌”了。 [*]骷髅牌选取时，要是能增加锁定功能就好了，被锁定的牌下次还能在选取时出现，这样不至于随机性太强太靠运气。 [/olist] [quote] 恭请雅鉴 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45531068/]黑白测评[/url] [hr]黑夜显真 白昼辨伪

The game clearly lacks combinations and skulls that can be buffed like in Balatro. I beat the game on my second attempt. It took about an hour to complete. There's no feeling of being "hooked" and wanting to play over and over — quite the opposite.

[h1][b]前有小丑牌，现有骷髅骰[/b][/h1] 《Dice of Kalma》便是一款以掷骰子为基础玩法的肉鸽构筑游戏，简单易上手，配合数量繁多的骷髅牌便能够打出爆炸高分。 本作采用了极简风画面，背景是冥界，玩家将作为迷路的灵魂与此地的守护者卡尔玛对决，而对决过程居然是掷骰子。 游戏的玩法很简单，一共5个骰子，每次投掷后可选择其中几个重新投掷，这个期间也可随时选择出牌，出牌后系统便会根据底分和倍率计算得分，玩家需要在出牌次数用光前达成目标得分。 牌型方面便是常见的排列组合，诸如单张、对子、三条、葫芦、四条、顺子、同花等。 游戏的精彩之处在于骷髅牌的加入，每次通过一个等级后便可以选择骷髅牌，其可以增强低分和倍率，还能够补充重新投掷次数，非常强力。 每张骷髅牌都有不同的触发条件，诸如重掷次数为0时触发、骰子呈对称排列时触发、牌型包含一个6点时触发、第一个和最后一个骰子数字之和为特定数字时触发、牌型数字按顺序升降时触发等。 只选择一两张骷髅牌时可能还没有立竿见影的效果，但当诸多骷髅牌效果叠加到一起时，几乎能覆盖任何牌型，这时候就产生质变了，再加上牌型的升级，很容易就能获得高分。 整体非常有趣的一款游戏，精致小巧，用丰富的构筑内容为简单的骰子玩法注入了源源不断的活力，值得推荐。 [quote]热爱游戏，畅玩游戏，分享游戏，专注鉴赏评测与深度解析 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44110339/]游理游据[/url]，走进游戏世界，品味第九艺术[/quote]

[h1]It’s basically Balatro with dice.[/h1] Minimalist visuals, but surprisingly deep gameplay. If you’re comfortable with statistics and probability, you’ll have a clear advantage and may enjoy it even more.
Really good and addicting game. Almost beat it, but was so close. Love the premise of it

Dice of Kalma is a remarkably addictive roguelike strategy game that blends poker-inspired dice mechanics, dark fantasy atmosphere, and combo-driven progression into a deeply satisfying experience built around probability, risk management, and increasingly absurd scoring synergies. Developed by Pepperbox Studios, the game takes a deceptively simple concept and transforms it into a tense and rewarding cycle of rerolls, upgrades, and strategic planning where every decision can completely reshape the outcome of a run. While comparisons to other modern score-focused roguelikes are inevitable, Dice of Kalma establishes its own identity quickly through its skull system, gothic presentation, and highly replayable structure. The premise centers around challenging Kalma, the mysterious ruler of the Underworld, in dangerous rounds of dice poker where survival depends on generating massive scores through carefully optimized builds. Every run places players into escalating encounters where they must roll dice to create poker-style hands while collecting powerful skulls capable of modifying rules, boosting scores, or triggering unusual effects. What initially appears straightforward gradually evolves into a highly strategic game of synergy-building where understanding combinations becomes far more important than simple luck. One of the game’s strongest features is its skull mechanic. Throughout each run, players acquire special skulls that dramatically alter how dice hands behave. Some reward certain hand combinations, others manipulate rerolls, increase multipliers, or trigger unique bonus effects when specific conditions are met. As more skulls begin interacting together, the game transforms into a satisfying puzzle of optimization where weak hands can suddenly explode into enormous point totals through carefully layered synergies. The poker-inspired structure gives the gameplay an immediately understandable foundation while still allowing for impressive strategic depth. Traditional combinations such as straights, matching dice, and high-value hands serve as the basic framework, but once upgrades and modifiers begin stacking together, the scoring system becomes far more complex. Players gradually shift from simply chasing strong hands to building entire strategies centered around specialized combinations and synergy chains capable of generating ridiculous amounts of points. The reroll system is another major highlight because it constantly creates meaningful tension. Every reroll forces players to decide whether to settle for a safe score or gamble for something potentially far more valuable. This constant balance between caution and greed becomes one of the game’s most addictive qualities. Some of the best moments come from taking dangerous risks on a final reroll and suddenly triggering an enormous combo that completely changes the direction of a run. What makes Dice of Kalma especially engaging is how naturally it balances randomness with player control. Luck always plays a role because dice outcomes are unpredictable, but successful runs depend far more on planning, adaptability, and understanding synergy interactions than blind fortune alone. The game consistently rewards players who experiment with builds, understand probability management, and learn how different skull effects interact together. The roguelike progression system works extremely well because every run develops differently depending on the upgrades and modifiers encountered. Some runs naturally evolve into aggressive high-risk builds focused on huge multipliers, while others reward safer and more consistent scoring strategies. Randomized skulls, upgrades, and modifiers constantly force players to adjust their plans rather than relying on repetitive solutions, which gives the game impressive replay value. Pacing is another area where the game succeeds. Runs move quickly without feeling shallow, maintaining a satisfying rhythm of rolling, rerolling, upgrading, and experimenting that keeps momentum high throughout long sessions. The game rarely wastes time and constantly introduces new opportunities for stronger combinations or riskier strategies. This fast but thoughtful pacing contributes heavily to the “one more run” feeling that defines successful roguelikes. The atmosphere also helps distinguish the game from many similar strategy titles. Dice of Kalma embraces a dark fantasy aesthetic filled with skull imagery, gothic visuals, eerie lighting, and Underworld themes that create a moody but stylish presentation. Kalma itself becomes a memorable presence looming over each run, reinforcing the game’s themes of risk, death, and persistence. Despite its relatively minimalist structure, the game maintains a surprisingly strong identity through its visual direction. Visually, the game succeeds through clarity and style rather than technical complexity. The interface remains readable even during chaotic late-game combinations, while the skull designs and visual effects provide enough variety to keep the gameplay visually engaging. Animations tied to large scoring chains and activated bonuses help successful turns feel rewarding and impactful. The sound design contributes heavily to the experience as well. Dice rolls, activated skull effects, and scoring sequences all produce satisfying audio feedback that reinforces the excitement of building successful combinations. The soundtrack maintains a dark but hypnotic tone that perfectly matches the game’s addictive gameplay loop and gothic atmosphere. Another impressive aspect is how accessible the game initially feels despite the hidden complexity beneath its systems. New players can understand the basic mechanics almost immediately, but the deeper strategic layers gradually reveal themselves through experimentation and repeated runs. This balance between accessibility and mastery gives the game long-term appeal without overwhelming players too early. However, Dice of Kalma is not completely without flaws. One noticeable issue is balancing. Certain skull combinations and upgraded hand strategies appear significantly more powerful than others, occasionally reducing build diversity once players discover particularly dominant synergies. Some strategies become so efficient that they overshadow less optimized approaches. The gameplay loop can also become repetitive during extremely long play sessions. Although the randomized systems create strong replayability overall, the core experience remains centered around probability management and score optimization. Players who are not naturally drawn to combo-heavy strategy games may eventually feel the repetition more strongly than dedicated roguelike fans. Difficulty progression may also frustrate some newer players. Early runs can feel punishing until players fully understand how reroll management, skull interactions, and hand upgrades work together. While experimentation is consistently rewarded, the learning curve may initially seem intimidating for players unfamiliar with strategy-focused roguelikes. Despite these shortcomings, Dice of Kalma succeeds because it fully commits to its core identity. The combination of dice poker mechanics, roguelike progression, dark fantasy atmosphere, and synergy-driven gameplay creates a remarkably satisfying gameplay loop that becomes increasingly engaging as players uncover stronger and more creative combinations. For fans of roguelike deckbuilders, probability-driven strategy games, and highly replayable indie titles focused on optimization and experimentation, Dice of Kalma delivers an excellent experience filled with tension, creativity, and addictive progression. Its blend of gothic atmosphere, rewarding strategic depth, and satisfying combo-building makes it one of the more memorable indie roguelikes currently available on Steam. Rating: 8/10
